name: Grandmother
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of grandmothers in passing down godly wisdom and faith to future generations, as seen in Deuteronomy 4:9 which urges careful teaching to sons and grandsons. The enduring mercy and righteousness of the Lord extend to children’s children (Psalms 103:17), emphasizing the spiritual legacy preserved through family lines. The faithful inheritance left by the righteous benefits not only their immediate offspring but also their grandchildren (Proverbs 13:22), encouraging a commitment to godly living that impacts multiple generations.
